text.name: October 7 and Gaza
text.rules: Record "the region on edge". Each side chooses: Press for a ceasefire? If LIO says yes, LIO spends 1 point on actions, then until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; otherwise, SAE spends 1 point on actions. If SAE says yes, SAE spends 1 point on actions, then until the end of this turn, each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; otherwise, LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: On 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel killed about 1,200 people and took 251 hostages. The war in Gaza that followed killed tens of thousands of people, according to Gaza's health ministry, and displaced most of its 2.1 million people.
